<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="560" height="500" viewBox="0 0 560 500" role="img" aria-label="About Aworkit dialog">

  <text data-adashi-id="about-developer-label" x="44" y="126" fill="#a9adb4" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12">Developer</text>
  <text data-adashi-id="about-developer-value" x="180" y="126" fill="#f0f0f0" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12">Timo Fleisch</text>

  <rect data-adashi-id="about-close-button" x="432" y="438" width="84" height="28" rx="4" fill="#3b6fd4"/>

</svg>
